critique: The cool blue-on-black Form particle treatment and evolving fluid motion are present, but the result still reads primarily as a deep noisy starfield. At t1 there are only faint hints of a grid, while by t4 the structure has fragmented into uneven clumps and scattered large foreground particles. The intended organized, planar grid being warped into readable random swirl patterns is not yet visually dominant.

suggestions.why: Collapse the six depth layers into a single lattice so the grid reads as a coherent surface instead of a volumetric starfield.
Remove the very large Z extent that creates oversized near particles and obscures the underlying XY grid structure.
Reduce random swirl displacement so the fluid motion bends the grid into legible swirling bands rather than rapidly breaking it into scattered clumps.
